name: tiered_fee_refund_credit_capped_rebate
question_template: A fictional merchant's card processor bills monthly. Gross card volume this month is {V} USD. Variable fees are marginal: {R1} percent on the first {C} USD of gross volume and {R2} percent on any gross volume above that breakpoint. Refunds of {R} USD in the same month earn a fee credit equal to refunded volume times the blended rate, where the blended rate is the gross variable fee divided by gross volume. Refunds also incur a surcharge of {F} percent of refunded volume, which is never credited. A loyalty rebate of {REB} percent applies to the net variable fee (gross variable fee minus refund credit, excluding the surcharge) and is capped at {CAP} USD per month. The net monthly fee equals gross variable fee minus refund credit plus surcharge minus rebate. What is the net monthly fee in USD?

slots.description: Gross variable fee from both marginal tiers before refunds.
Fee credit returned on refunded volume at the blended rate.
Loyalty rebate actually applied after the monthly cap.

program:
def solve():
    V = P["V"]
    C = P["C"]
    r1 = P["R1"] / 100
    r2 = P["R2"] / 100
    R = P["R"]
    f = P["F"] / 100
    reb = P["REB"] / 100
    cap = P["CAP"]
    if R > V:
        raise ValueError("refunded volume exceeds gross volume")
    tier1 = min(V, C)
    tier2 = max(V - C, 0)
    gross = tier1 * r1 + tier2 * r2
    blended = gross / V
    credit = R * blended
    surcharge = R * f
    net_var = gross - credit
    rebate = min(reb * net_var, cap)
    final = gross - credit + surcharge - rebate
    return {
        "final": final,
        "gross_variable_fee": gross,
        "refund_credit": credit,
        "rebate_applied": rebate,
    }
